tagline: 柯尼卡便携相机，2001 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于2001年推出的便携相机。配备1:3,9-1:7,9/23-50mm zoom。快门速度1 sec. down to 1/500 sec. controlled by spot focusing CdS-photo resistor。active multi-infrared-autofocus system。

specs.快门速度: 1 sec. down to 1/500 sec. controlled by spot focusing CdS-photo resistor
specs.闪光灯: reaching as far as 6.8 meters when zoom lens is in wide angle position
specs.取景器: magnification depending on the zoom lens' position
specs.英文简介: The Konica Revio II is an APS film compact camera with a zoom lens.
